release_notes: v1.6.2 (corrupt-memo-resilient) — Field report from NAVDURGA AUTO SPARES JABALPUR (COMP0001 NAV 26-27): the agent aborted at Phase 1/15 (customers) with `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable` deep inside `access_parser._parse_memo`. One row in that company's `Master1` table has a memo field with a null overflow pointer and the library crashed trying to dereference the missing overflow page. Fix: THREE layers of defence — (1) monkey-patch `access_parser.AccessTable._parse_memo` at import time to swallow TypeError/IndexError/AttributeError/KeyError/ValueError and return "" instead; (2) wrap `self._ap.parse_table()` in try/except — a crash on one table degrades to empty rows for that cycle, remaining phases keep running; (3) wrap each of the 15 sync phases in `run_full_sync` in its own try/except so one failing extractor can no longer abort the other 14. Expected outcome on NAVDURGA's PC: Phase 1 customers either completes cleanly (if the one corrupt row's memo is just empty) or logs `[access_parser.patch] skipped corrupt memo cell` and continues — Phases 2-15 (creditors, inventory, sales, receipts, payments, credit/debit notes, journals, purchases, P&L, ledgers) will run regardless. Also includes v1.6.1 (StockGroup name fix + customer group-hierarchy traversal). Rebuild via `build-kit-busy\build.bat`.
